episodes.title: Home
episodes.summary: After receiving a disturbing call about her sister's sudden disappearance, one twin returns to her hometown, where an investigation is already underway.

episodes.title: Birthday
episodes.summary: Leni walks a precarious line as she scrambles to keep up appearances and look for answers about what happened in Mt. Echo over the past year.

episodes.title: Party
episodes.summary: Leni reconnects with old friends and realizes that Gina may be closer than she thought. Later, the whole town shows up to the twins' birthday party.

episodes.title: Body
episodes.summary: When the police discover a burned body in the woods, suspicion turns uncomfortably close to home. Leni searches for Gina.

episodes.title: Gina
episodes.summary: Painful memories resurface for Gina as she reflects on her childhood with Leni, bringing new revelations to light.

episodes.title: Fire
episodes.summary: In the midst of an intense investigation, Sheriff Floss brings both sisters in for questioning, and Leni and Gina tell two very different stories.

episodes.title: Falls
episodes.summary: On the run and with nowhere left to hide, Leni and Gina must finally face their past — and each other.
